subject: P01
required_fixes: RF01 (P2) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:1193 removes the tenant's ScanRecords before the deletion's save_with at line 1197 succeeds. On a pre-write storage failure, save_with restores only Data (lines 732–755); scans are separate State fields (lines 395–445) and remain removed. DeleteTenant therefore returns DeniedStore with the tenant, credential and context restored, but its history is lost. An admitted running or queued scan still exists in Operations and may execute/complete, while observe no longer exposes it and CancelScan rejects its operation as InvalidInput because it first requires a matching ScanRecord (lines 1518–1523). This combines C02 rollback with C03 lifecycle state and makes refused deletion destroy observability and cancellation. Stage the scan-record removal until the deletion is accepted, or restore it on refusal. Acceptance: through production dispatch/observe with ScriptedStore.fail_saves(true), attempt deletion of an active tenant with settled history plus running and queued synthetic scans; assert refusal preserves the tenant/context/credential and all records, the original operations remain cancellable, their outcomes stay observable, and nothing is replayed. Also retain successful-deletion coverage. The existing failed-save test covers creation/key configuration, and the deletion test covers only successful deletion; add this composition regression and rerun affected source-bound P01 checks/native evidence.
